name: PM-KISAN
summary: Direct income support for land-holding farmer families.
benefit: ₹6,000 a year, paid in three instalments of ₹2,000 straight to the bank account.

all.label: Family owns cultivable land in their name
No family member paid income tax last year
Not a serving or retired government employee

howToApply: Register on pmkisan.gov.in under 'New Farmer Registration', or visit a Common Service Centre (CSC).
Complete e-KYC with Aadhaar OTP or biometrics.
The state verifies land records before the first instalment.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
summary: Free hospital treatment for poor and vulnerable families.
benefit: Cashless hospital cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year at empanelled public and private hospitals.

anyOf.label: Holds a BPL / Antyodaya / priority ration card
Landless or casual manual labour household

verifyNote: Final eligibility is matched against the SECC-2011 / state beneficiary list at the Ayushman card counter.
howToApply: Check your name on beneficiary.nha.gov.in or the Ayushman app.
Get your Ayushman card made at a CSC, empanelled hospital (Arogya Mitra) or via the app with Aadhaar e-KYC.

name: Ayushman Vay Vandana (70+)
summary: Health cover for every senior citizen aged 70 or above, regardless of income.
benefit: ₹5 lakh a year cashless hospital cover for senior citizens aged 70+, on top of any existing family cover.
howToApply: Enrol on the Ayushman app or beneficiary.nha.gov.in using Aadhaar e-KYC.
Or visit any empanelled hospital or CSC.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension (NSAP)
summary: Monthly pension for elderly people from BPL households.
benefit: Central share of ₹200 a month (age 60–79) or ₹500 a month (80+). Most states add their own top-up.
cashNote: Central share only; your state usually pays more.
howToApply: Apply at the Gram Panchayat / Block office (rural) or municipal office (urban), or through your state's social welfare portal.
Many states accept applications at CSCs.

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension (NSAP)
summary: Monthly pension for widows from BPL households.
benefit: Central share of ₹300 a month. States add their own amount.
cashNote: Central share only; your state usually pays more.
howToApply: Apply at the Gram Panchayat / Block office or municipal office, or your state's social welfare portal.
Many states accept applications at CSCs.

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension (NSAP)
summary: Monthly pension for people with severe disability from BPL households.
benefit: Central share of ₹300 a month. States add their own amount.
cashNote: Central share only; your state usually pays more.
howToApply: Apply at the Block / municipal social welfare office or state portal.
Get a UDID card at swavlambancard.gov.in if you don't have one.

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
summary: Free LPG connection for women from poor households.
benefit: Deposit-free LPG connection with first refill and stove, plus a targeted subsidy on refills paid to the bank account.

all.label: No LPG connection in the household

anyOf.label: Lives in a kutcha house (PMAY-G category)

documents: Aadhaar of applicant and adult family members
howToApply: Apply online at pmuy.gov.in or at the nearest LPG distributor (Indane, Bharat Gas, HP Gas).

name: PM Awas Yojana – Gramin
summary: Money to build a pucca house for rural families who don't have one.
benefit: ₹1.2 lakh (plains) or ₹1.3 lakh (hilly / difficult areas) to build a pucca house, plus MGNREGA wage days and toilet support.
verifyNote: Beneficiaries are selected from the Awaas+ survey and approved by the Gram Sabha.
documents: Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM) number, if any
howToApply: Ask at the Gram Panchayat to be included in the Awaas+ survey / list.
Track status on pmayg.dord.gov.in.

name: PM Awas Yojana – Urban 2.0
summary: Help to build, buy or rent a house for urban EWS, LIG and MIG families.
benefit: About ₹2.5 lakh per house (central + state share) to build or buy, or an interest subsidy on a home loan.

all.label: No pucca house anywhere in India in the family's name
Household income up to ₹9 lakh a year

documents: Land documents (if building on own land)
howToApply: Apply on pmay-urban.gov.in or at your Urban Local Body (municipality) office.

name: PM Jan Dhan Yojana
summary: A free zero-balance bank account for anyone who doesn't have one.
benefit: Zero-balance savings account with RuPay card, ₹2 lakh accident insurance, and overdraft up to ₹10,000 for eligible holders.

all.label: Does not have a bank account

documents: Aadhaar card (or any officially valid ID)
howToApply: Visit any bank branch or Bank Mitra (business correspondent) and ask for a Jan Dhan account.

name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
summary: Low-cost life insurance through your bank account.
benefit: ₹2 lakh life cover for ₹436 a year, auto-debited from your bank account.

all.label: Has a bank or post office account

howToApply: Enrol at your bank branch, net banking, or the Jan Suraksha portal.

name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana
summary: Accident insurance for ₹20 a year.
benefit: ₹2 lakh cover for accidental death or full disability (₹1 lakh partial) for ₹20 a year.

all.label: Has a bank or post office account

howToApply: Enrol at your bank branch, net banking, or the Jan Suraksha portal.

name: Atal Pension Yojana
summary: A guaranteed pension at 60 for small monthly contributions.
benefit: Guaranteed pension of ₹1,000–₹5,000 a month from age 60, depending on what you contribute.
howToApply: Enrol at your bank branch or post office, or through net banking.

name: MGNREGA
summary: Guaranteed paid work for rural households.
benefit: Up to 100 days of paid unskilled work a year per household at the state-notified wage, paid to the bank account.

all.label: Adult member willing to do unskilled work

howToApply: Apply for a job card at the Gram Panchayat (written or oral request).
Ask for work in writing; work must be given within 15 days.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
summary: A high-interest savings account for a girl child.
benefit: Savings account for a daughter under 10 with government-set interest (reviewed quarterly); tax-free maturity at 21.
documents: Parent / guardian Aadhaar and address proof
howToApply: Open the account at any post office or authorised bank branch with a minimum ₹250 deposit.

name: PM Mudra Yojana
summary: Collateral-free loans for small non-farm businesses.
benefit: Collateral-free business loans: Shishu up to ₹50,000, Kishore up to ₹5 lakh, Tarun up to ₹10 lakh, Tarun Plus up to ₹20 lakh.

anyOf.label: Runs a small business, shop or trade
Plans to start a small business

documents: Business plan or proof of business
howToApply: Apply at any bank, NBFC or MFI, or online at jansamarth.in.

name: PM Vishwakarma
summary: Support for traditional artisans and craftspeople in 18 trades.
benefit: Training with ₹500/day stipend, ₹15,000 toolkit e-voucher, collateral-free loans of ₹1 lakh then ₹2 lakh at 5% interest, and a PM Vishwakarma certificate.

all.label: Works as a traditional artisan (carpenter, potter, tailor, blacksmith, etc.)
No family member in government service

howToApply: Register through a Common Service Centre (CSC) on pmvishwakarma.gov.in.
Verification is done by the Gram Panchayat / ULB, then district and state committees.

name: PM SVANidhi
summary: Working-capital loans for street vendors.
benefit: Collateral-free loans of ₹15,000, then ₹25,000, then ₹50,000, with an interest subsidy and cashback on digital payments.

all.label: Works as a street vendor / hawker

documents: Vending certificate or Letter of Recommendation from the ULB
howToApply: Apply on pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in, via a CSC, or at a bank branch.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
name_hi: अनुसूचित जाति छात्रों हेतु पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति
summary: Fees and allowance for SC students studying beyond Class 10.
benefit: Compulsory fees reimbursed plus a monthly maintenance allowance, from Class 11 up to PhD.

all.label: Family income up to ₹2.5 lakh a year

howToApply: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) or your state scholarship portal before the deadline.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
name_hi: अनुसूचित जनजाति छात्रों हेतु पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति
summary: Fees and allowance for ST students studying beyond Class 10.
benefit: Compulsory fees reimbursed plus a maintenance allowance for post-matric courses.

all.label: Family income up to ₹2.5 lakh a year

howToApply: Apply on scholarships.gov.in or your state's tribal welfare scholarship portal.

name: Central Sector Scholarship for College Students
summary: Merit scholarship for college students from lower-income families.
benefit: ₹12,000 a year during graduation (first three years) and ₹20,000 a year at postgraduate level.

all.label: Enrolled in a regular college / university course
Scored above the 80th percentile in Class 12 board
Family income up to ₹4.5 lakh a year

howToApply: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) during the open window.

name: PM Matru Vandana Yojana
summary: Cash support for pregnant women and new mothers.
benefit: ₹5,000 in instalments for the first child, and ₹6,000 for a second child if it is a girl.
howToApply: Register through your Anganwadi worker or ASHA, or on pmmvy.wcd.gov.in.

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana
summary: Low-premium crop insurance, including for tenant farmers.
benefit: Crop insurance at just 2% premium (kharif), 1.5% (rabi) or 5% (commercial / horticulture); the government pays the rest.
documents: Land record or tenancy / sowing certificate
howToApply: Enrol on pmfby.gov.in, at a CSC, bank, or insurance agent before the season's cut-off date.

name: Kisan Credit Card
summary: Cheap crop and working-capital credit for farmers and fishers.
benefit: Revolving credit for farming needs; with interest subvention the effective rate is about 4% on loans up to ₹5 lakh repaid on time.
howToApply: Apply at any bank branch; PM-KISAN beneficiaries can use the simplified KCC form on pmkisan.gov.in.

name: Stand-Up India
summary: Bank loans for women and SC/ST entrepreneurs starting a new business.
benefit: Bank loans from ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore for a new (greenfield) enterprise in manufacturing, services, trading or agri-allied activity.
howToApply: Apply on standupmitra.in or at a bank branch.

name: PM Shram Yogi Maandhan
summary: Pension for unorganised workers earning up to ₹15,000 a month.
benefit: ₹3,000 a month pension from age 60. You pay ₹55–₹200 a month (by age); the government matches it.

all.label: Not covered by EPFO / ESIC / NPS

howToApply: Enrol at a Common Service Centre or on maandhan.in.

name: e-Shram Card
summary: National registration for unorganised workers.
benefit: e-Shram card with a Universal Account Number, a gateway to social security schemes and accident cover under PMSBY.

all.label: Not a member of EPFO / ESIC

howToApply: Self-register on eshram.gov.in with Aadhaar OTP, or visit a CSC.
